sophia: Draft RN for late patch (runtime v2.3.9). Window 23:50 PT -> 00:30 PT. Fixes: batching stall under burst, Dedicated autoscale cooldown, KV cache init guard. Need quick sign-off and rollback thresholds.

sam-ops: I'll run deploy. Canary plan: 5% -> 30% -> 100% with 10m holds. Rollback triggers: sustained error-rate >=2% for 5m OR p95 >800ms for 8m. Rollback will pin to v2.3.8 for 30m.

lee: RN nit: change "KV cache init guard" -> "KV cache NPE protection". Add Known Impact: "Short reconnects for Dedicated customers during scaling."

alia: Added runbook link in RN: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/runtime-deploy and oncall list @oncall-runtime, @infra-ops.

sam-ops: Deploybot queued when staging smoke green. Command:
```
/deploy service=runtime version=v2.3.9 canary=5% step=10m health=svc-metrics-check
```
To cancel: `deploybot cancel 1777771717`. Rollback cmd saved.

deploybot: deploy queued by sam-ops. Staging smoke OK. Will post step updates here.

sophia: Thanks — I'll cut a 23:35 PT staff brief and post the RN. Everyone ok with thresholds and 30m pin?

lee: OK.

alia: OK.

sam-ops: OK, starting at 23:50 unless hold. :rocket:
